findings.evidenceJa: もう用済みって言った
findings.governingReading: he said Shirou was no longer needed or had served his purpose
findings.explanation: A change in Zouken’s instrumental need is turned into an intrinsic judgment of worthlessness.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why you’re useless now
findings.evidenceJa: そっちの方はてんで予想がつかない
findings.governingReading: Rin cannot begin to guess the reason she herself still has utility to Zouken
findings.explanation: The English reverses the person and polarity of Rin’s uncertainty: her unexplained usefulness becomes Shirou’s uselessness.

findings.evidenceJa: ふむ、と遠坂は考え込む
findings.governingReading: with a “hmm,” Tohsaka sinks into thought
findings.explanation: The audible thoughtful cue preceding her silence is omitted.
